name: Flight Tracker
author: fbnlrz
description: Live flight status, schedule and airborne position for a flight reservation, from AeroDataBox and adsb.fi.

settings.label: AeroDataBox RapidAPI key
settings.hint: Instance-wide, admin-managed: one key serves every user. Set it in the widget (admins see an 'Add AeroDataBox key' field on any flight) or via the admin API: PUT /api/admin/plugins/flight-tracker/config. A key set through the API always takes precedence over one entered in the widget. Get a free key at rapidapi.com/aedbx-aedbx/api/aerodatabox. Without it, only the live position from adsb.fi is shown.

settings.label: Flight change notifications
settings.hint: Bell and email alerts for delays, gate changes, cancellations and diversions on your own flights. Defaults to on.

settings.label: Alert me from this delay onwards (minutes)
settings.hint: Delays shorter than this are not notified and are not raised as a trip warning. Defaults to 15 minutes.
